content.title: FIVN Q3 Deep Dive: AI-Driven Bookings and Operational Shifts Shape Outlook
content.summary: Cloud contact center software provider Five9 (NASDAQ:FIVN) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 8.2% year on year to $285.8 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $297.7 million was less impressive, coming in 0.8% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.78 per share was 6.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
